q3.explanation: Every tool adds responsibility as well as capability.

review-cloud-identity.explanation: Trust and action permissions are separate.

review-cloud-networking.explanation: A subnet is an AZ-scoped network range.

review-cloud-ec2.explanation: A VM does not manage the whole application lifecycle.

review-cloud-load-balancing.explanation: Traffic routing is an explicit layer.

review-cloud-s3.explanation: It can be used while its permission and expiry remain valid.

review-cloud-cloudfront.explanation: Identity and forwarded dimensions must match response variation.

review-cloud-elasticache.explanation: Their correctness and recovery requirements differ.

review-cloud-sqs.explanation: Receipt and deletion are distinct operations.

review-cloud-sns.explanation: Each logical subscriber has its own work to do.

review-cloud-lambda.explanation: Invocation/acknowledgement semantics depend on the event source.

review-cloud-ecr.explanation: A digest identifies the image bytes.

review-cloud-eks.explanation: Workload and control-plane health are separate.

review-cloud-msk.explanation: The application still needs an outbox or another explicit consistency design.

review-cloud-secrets-kms.explanation: Secrets and cryptographic keys have different lifecycles and APIs.
